title: Daily Signal Brief 050 — Article 50 T+2; four coordination clocks past Tuesday T+2 catch-up window
summary: Article 50 of the EU AI Act is at T+2 post-general-application; the Commission's 20 July 2026 Guidelines and Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content carry unchanged as the two Commission-authoritative anchors, and two additional legal-practitioner-side reads landed in the T+0 → T+2 window (National Law Review's 'EU AI Act — Final Guidelines on Transparency Obligations under Article 50' and Enzai's 'EU AI Act Article 50: Final Guidance Is Here') — both directly citable by any enterprise-EU buyer opening Stratum's /trust page this week. Tuesday 14:01Z T+2 catch-up window closed empty on all three Article 50 artefacts (Kernel v1.3 transparent-marking probe scope note; Compass /trust and /compare paragraph swap; Vector EU-buyer talking-point); third consecutive foreclosed discharge window (Friday-pre-emptive + Monday-reactive + Tuesday-T+2-catch-up). Wednesday–Friday landings still discharge at T+3-to-T+5 catch-up with 'week one' framing truthful only if posted before Friday 7 August 14:01Z; every business day past Tuesday narrows the 'week one' framing by twenty percent. Coordination triangle holds at four clocks with five-consecutive-dispatch stability (Thu-Fri-Mon-Tue + today): only commit since 7/31 brief is Eglin's own 8/03 daily — twenty-first revised-ETA null in twenty-seven business days on the standing Tier 4 vehicle; Forge R1 verdict clock at twelve calendar / eight business days elapsed (Monday's 'Tuesday routing prevents crossing twelve/eight' did not land, the clock crossed); Kernel v1.3 four full business days past Wednesday-due; Compass /trust and /compare one-and-a-half business days past Monday reactive and at Tuesday T+2 catch-up. MCP mainline T+7: no net-new mainline read landed in 24h; the T+6 anchoring set (Akamai + News4Hackers + SecurityWeek + InfoQ EMA + 4sysops) carries unchanged; Bersin + HRTechFeed extend null to sixth observation across MCP mainline T+7 + Workable 94-tools T+15. Mobley twice-weekly D+43 / D+31 passive-tail null; TA-lane 11-vendor 24h scan null on any Article-50-aligned artefact filed Monday or Tuesday morning — reactive-posture-across-boundary confirmed a second consecutive scan window. Weekly digest publishes tonight 18:00Z under /intel/eglin/weekly/ as its own dispatch (not a second slip), folding Article 50 T+2 status with National Law Review + Enzai legal-practitioner-side reads, the four-clock five-consecutive-dispatch stability arc, the analyst-registry design proposal with sixth-observation supporting data, the security-thicker-than-devops MCP mainline finding, the TA-lane-null-a-second-consecutive-day observation, and the Commission-daily-news pre-commit lesson.
